initiative.title: Check releases, not every pull request
initiative.summary: Move the full check suite from every PR to the release path, so main may break between releases but nothing broken is published.
initiative.next_action: Byron answers the three intent questions, then shape where the release-path suite runs.

sources.notes: "create a new initiative which does checks only on the release PR. Basically these constant pr checks are too much. I am OK with some breakage on main as long as it never gets released."
The 2026-10-12 session fixed failing checks but never created this initiative; the retro recovered the request.
About 165 PR workflow runs between 2026-10-11 and 2026-10-13. Version Packages PR #383 (opened by github-actions) reports no checks.

claims.statement: Nothing broken reaches npm or the team server image.
Per-PR checks are too much; stop gating every PR on the full suite.
Some breakage on main is acceptable as long as it is never released.
Checks run on the release PR.
claims.notes: Literal mechanism; the Version Packages PR gets no pull_request runs because Changesets opens it with GITHUB_TOKEN, so the shape must pick another trigger.

claims.statement: pnpm run release already runs pnpm check before changeset publish; docs:verify and the smokes are not on the release path.
The Pages deploy runs on every push to main and gates on build, demo tests, and docs:verify.

themes.name: Verification belongs at the release boundary

conflicts.summary: "Checks on the release PR" cannot run as-is: PRs opened with GITHUB_TOKEN do not trigger pull_request workflows.
conflicts.resolution: open — choose a trigger in shaping
